S81-SHLK 10-18 (route dsdv_sh_lk-ef442ffba NEEDS_RTL TT -36.2 / FF +8.14 / DRC 0, 173 endpoints: 86 u_hx.mem (ck_ih) -> head decode -> hx_pop -> rbin_c / ofree (ck_ic, 150-ps root-pair uncertainty), 73 u_hx.rbin_c -> 16:1 x 514-b read mux -> u_eng.dq, 11 u_eng.ra_rp[5] -> 512-b realigner select/shift -> ox_w_q / sc_acc): ingest APIPE 7 = registered FWFT host-FIFO head in clk_i (every head decode and the descriptor queue start at a ck_ic flop; host words +1 ck_ic edge, rate unchanged: host_native_pipe pos7 ck 1068/8473/532/633/1353 vs APIPE 6 1068/8472/532/630/1353) + 8 kept copies of the realigner pointer ra_rp (one per 32-b head slice; no cycle change). Host path f_host -> s_hw / t_host = golden + 2 edges (tb HSH 2); token path and every other port unchanged. S81-SHLK2 10-18 (APIPE-6 view 743e0021b native audit FAIL, receipt results/closure/shlk_pick_1018/native_audit.json: launch 254.9 > 220 vo_s[251], capture 201.0 > 190 st_rg_e[1], pin-flop spread TT 94.0 / FF 88.3 > 80): BOUNDARY STRUCTURE. (1) The single-flop rung hop (rn_o <= vi_s, vo_s <= rs_i) joined the S face to the N face 136 um apart with ONE flop: io_flop_at_pins anchored all 552 rung flops at N (y 131-134), so vo_s carried 136 um of output wire (S-face outputs x 75-175 launch 129-255) and vi_s 136 um of input wire (capture 87-188).  RL 1: the rung is LANDED at both faces, capture flop beside the input pin and launch flop beside the output pin (vi_s -> vi_q S -> rn_o N; rs_i -> rs_q N -> vo_s S), +1 edge each way (rung 6 -> 7 in dsdv_seq_host, V south command -> vo_s 7 -> 8; compiler dv_layer_compile SEQ vo_s_land 1).  (2) st_rg_w (NE corner) and st_rg_e (SE corner) folded into ONE flop between them (130 um from st_rg_e): each now lands in its own pin flop before the fold (+1 edge on the region status word). (3) Clock: ONE CTS root ck for the whole leaf (clock cts; ck_ih / ck_ic ports and pins removed, ingest clk_h = clk_i = ck as in dsdv_seq_host). The three related roots existed only for the retired 15k sinks-per-root cap (S81U-SEQ3) and cost the die-skew reserve (hold 100 / setup 150..210 ps) on every ck <-> ingest crossing: 20,461 FF hold endpoints and ~20k hold buffers at the APIPE-7 gate, and the post-repair boundary tail (APIPE-6 routed TT 230.3..321.6).  Re-CTS sweep on the APIPE-7 gate placement: one root, boundary spread TT 17.5 ps (route.cts_sink size 20 / dia 40 / levels 2 / dbb 60 / unbalance 0.5) vs 45.7 ps for the three-root ck tree; insertion 252 mean. Clock pin ck stays at E (254.88, 67.76), beside the tile centroid row (flop centroid 124, 66). Benches (ot-epyc5, Verilator 5.050): seeds 1-8 PASS, collide / stdrop fault, mutants 1-9 FAIL (9 = landing dropped), lint clean; witnesses results/rtl/s81_shlk_1018/rl1/.
